raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.3.0"
  # used in host and run
  ast_serialize_min: "0.6.0"
  ast_serialize_max: "1.0.0"
  mypy_extensions_min: "1.0.0"
  pathspec_min: "1.0.0"
  python_librt_min: "0.13.0"
  tomli_min: "1.1.0"
  typing_extensions_min: "4.6.0"
  psutil_min: "4.0"
  setuptools_min: "77.0.3"
  # test
  python_self_check: "3.10"
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  py_bin: ${{ "so" if unix else "pyd" }}

recipe:
  name: mypy-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/m/mypy/mypy-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 465965d41cd9a2726694e983e8ce7113259327bec798115d1e1dfa2a52fb666e

build:
  number: 0
  # fails after two hours with:
  # {standard input}:19746030: Error: operand out of range (0xfffffffffdfce3e8 is not between 0xfffffffffe000000 and 0x1fffffc)
  skip: target_platform == "linux-ppc64le" and "cp314t" in python

outputs:
  - package:
      name: mypy
    build:
      script:
        env:
          MYPY_USE_MYPYC: "1"
        content:
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
      python:
        entry_points:
          - mypy = mypy.__main__:console_entry
          - stubgen = mypy.stubgen:main
          - dmypy = mypy.dmypy.client:console_entry
          - stubtest = mypy.stubtest:main
          - mypyc = mypyc.__main__:main
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - ast-serialize >=${{ ast_serialize_min }},<${{ ast_serialize_max }}
        - mypy_extensions >=${{ mypy_extensions_min }}
        - pathspec >=${{ pathspec_min }}
        - pathspec >=${{ pathspec_min }}
        - pip
        - python
        - python-librt >=${{ python_librt_min }}
        - setuptools >=${{ setuptools_min }}
        - types-psutil
        - types-setuptools
        - typing_extensions >=${{ typing_extensions_min }}
        - if: match(python, "<3.11")
          then:
            - tomli >=${{ tomli_min }}
      run:
        - ast-serialize >=${{ ast_serialize_min }},<${{ ast_serialize_max }}
        - mypy_extensions >=${{ mypy_extensions_min }}
        - pathspec >=${{ pathspec_min }}
        - python
        - python-librt >=${{ python_librt_min }}
        - typing_extensions >=${{ typing_extensions_min }}
        # extra: dmypy
        - psutil >=${{ psutil_min }}
        - if: match(python, "<3.11")
          then:
            - tomli >=${{ tomli_min }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - mypy
            - mypy.dmypy
            - mypy.plugins
            - mypy.server
          pip_check: true
      - package_contents:
          site_packages:
            - mypy/*.${{ py_bin }}
      - script:
          - mkdir tmp || md tmp
          - cd tmp
          - dmypy --help
          - mypy --help
          - stubgen --help
          - stubtest --help
      - files:
          source:
            - mypy_self_check.ini
            - pyproject.toml
        requirements:
          run:
            - attrs
            - filelock
            - lxml
            - psutil
            - pytest
            - pytest-xdist
            - setuptools
            - tomli
            - types-psutil
        script:
          - if: target_platform == "linux-ppc64le"
            then:
              - echo "self-check fails on linux-ppc64le"
            else:
              # 20 tests fail due to assumptions about relative paths in site-packages
              # - pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes --pyargs mypy
              - mypy -p mypy --num-workers=2 --config-file=mypy_self_check.ini --python-version=${{ python_self_check }}

  - package:
      name: mypyc
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("mypy", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - python
        - setuptools >=50
    tests:
      - files:
          recipe:
            - test_mypyc.py
        script:
          - mypyc --help
          - python test_mypyc.py
    about:
      license: MIT
      license_file: LICENSE
      summary: Mypyc compiles Python modules to C extensions. It uses standard Python type hints to generate fast code.
      description: |
        The compiled language is a strict, gradually typed Python variant. It
        restricts the use of some dynamic Python features to gain performance,
        but it's mostly compatible with standard Python.

        Mypyc uses mypy to perform type checking and type inference. Most type
        system features in the stdlib typing module are supported.

        Compiled modules can import arbitrary Python modules and third-party
        libraries. You can compile anything from a single performance-critical
        module to your entire codebase. You can run the modules you compile also
        as normal, interpreted Python modules.

        Existing code with type annotations is often 1.5x to 5x faster when
        compiled. Code tuned for mypyc can be 5x to 10x faster.

        Mypyc currently aims to speed up non-numeric code, such as server
        applications. Mypyc is also used to compile itself (and mypy).
      homepage: https://mypyc.readthedocs.io
      repository: https://github.com/python/mypy/blob/master/mypyc

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Optional static typing for Python
  description: |
    Add type annotations to your Python programs, and use mypy to type check
    them. Mypy is essentially a Python linter on steroids, and it can catch
    many programming errors by analyzing your program, without actually having
    to run it.  Mypy has a powerful type system with features such as type
    inference, gradual typing, generics and union types.
  homepage: http://mypy-lang.org
  repository: https://github.com/python/mypy
  documentation: http://mypy.readthedocs.io

  recipe-maintainers:

    - matthiasdiener
